subject: Scoped evidence delivery & proxy upload account — AcmeCloud preflight
messages:
From: Samir Patel <security@acmecloud.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 19 Oct 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Scoped evidence delivery & proxy upload account — AcmeCloud preflight

Hi Marissa,

Thanks for taking this on. We need a short-lived upload mechanism and a small manifest for the SOC2/SIG artifacts collection. A few constraints from our side:
- We prefer ephemeral S3 pre-signed URLs scoped to a single, flat prefix (no recursive uploads).
- TTL: tokens should expire within 12 hours; longer-lived service accounts will need an audit justification.
- We want a simple CSV manifest (filename, sha256, size, created_at, proof_owner). Ideally the manifest is validated by a small lambda on our side.

Two questions for the preflight:
1) Can you provide a delegated "proxy" upload account (not the main portal service account) limited to a specific bucket/prefix?
2) If S3 presign isn't workable, can you provision a temporary SFTP user for a 48h window and share connection details?

We have a procurement wrinkle: Lena from procurement will want an upload SLA note in the onboarding packet. Looping her in.

Appreciate a quick heads-up on which approach works for Redwood.

Thanks,
Samir
Security Operations — AcmeCloud

Attachments: requested-evidence-samples.xlsx (stub)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Samir Patel <security@acmecloud.com>
Cc: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 19 Oct 2026 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Scoped evidence delivery & proxy upload account — AcmeCloud preflight

Hi Samir —

Thanks for the clear constraints. Short answer: yes, we can do an ephemeral S3 presign flow and we can also spin up a temporary SFTP user as a fallback. A couple of implementation notes and proposed next steps:

Plan A (preferred): presigned uploads- Provision a delegated IAM role scoped to acme-evidence/uploads/{customer-id}/acmecloud/
- We will issue presigned POST URLs via a short-lived token (12h TTL by default) and enforce a manifest check on upload completion.
- We will publish a lightweight playbook (attached) explaining the presign handshake and recommended manifest format.

Plan B (fallback): temp SFTP account- 48h window, restricted to a single chrooted directory, audit logs forwarded to your syslog endpoint.

Operational asks from AcmeCloud:
- Confirm the exact prefix you want us to lock (e.g., acme-evidence/uploads/acmecloud/2026-10-19/)
- Confirm whether your lambda validator needs a specific content-type or metadata key to validate the manifest signature.

Action items:
- Priya, can you prepare the delegated role request and the manifest template?
- Jordan, can you run a quick internal security checklist for the delegated role (least privilege + key rotation note)?

Samir — I'll get the presign playbook attached to this thread and propose a 30-min call tomorrow to do a run-through.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Manager, Vendor Security & Onboarding
Redwood Inference

Attachments: s3-presign-playbook.pdf (stub), acme_manifest_v2.csv (stub)

From: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 19 Oct 2026 13:20:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Scoped evidence delivery & proxy upload account — AcmeCloud preflight

Marissa / Priya —

Quick checklist results from my end:
- IAM role scoping: OK. We can restrict AssumeRole to a service principal and require MFA for long-lived sessions.
- S3 policy: put ObjectPrefix and PutObject permissions only; add a condition to require x-amz-meta-proof-owner header to match manifest proof_owner.
- Audit: CloudTrail bucket will replicate logs to our security retention account; we should include a retention period in the onboarding doc (default 365 days).

One caution: presigned POSTs can't enforce header requirements at the S3 ACL level unless you embed them in the policy; include that in the playbook. Also recommend we rotate the delegated role every 90 days and log rotations in the onboarding HubSpot ticket.

I'll draft the role ARNs and a sample bucket policy and drop it in the Drive folder.

-Jordan
Security Engineer, Redwood Inference

Cc: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 21 Oct 2026 16:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Scoped evidence delivery & proxy upload account — AcmeCloud preflight

Hi Samir / Lena —

Per Jordan's checklist we provisioned a delegated role and created a single-prefix bucket: s3://redwood-evidence/acmecloud/2026-10-21/. The presign playbook (attached) includes the preflight manifest format and an example presign POST call. Notes:
- Presigned URLs issued via our /internal/upload-token endpoint; tokens expire in 12 hours.
- Manifest validation: we check sha256 and content-length on arrival and record proof_owner metadata. If validation fails we reject the object and post an error to the provided webhook.
- Retention: logs retained 365 days; artifacts retained per your contract (default 90 days unless you request otherwise).

Next steps for AcmeCloud:
1) Confirm the prefix above is acceptable — if yes we'll provide the first set of presigned URLs for your validator test.
2) Procurement: Lena, we included a short note about upload SLA (48h for onboarding batches). Let us know if you need modifications.

If you'd like a walkthrough, Priya and I can join a 30-min session Thursday at 10am PT.

Cheers,
Marissa
Manager, Vendor Security & Onboarding
Redwood Inference
